description: Confirmation receipt sent to the person who submitted an incident report in the First Aid Portal.
subject: Your First Aid Incident Report — $reference
body:
Dear $reporter_name,

This is to confirm that your incident report has been received and forwarded to the University Health & Safety team. A first aid officer will be notified.

Your Report:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Reference:      $reference
Incident Type:  $incident_type
Severity:       $severity
Location:       $location
Reported:       $submitted_at
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

What you reported:
$description

What happens next:
• The Health & Safety team has been notified by email.
• Keep the reference above for any follow-up.
• For any life-threatening emergency, always call 911.

If you did not submit this report, please contact the University Health Center immediately.

Kind regards,
University Health & Safety Department

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
This is an automated confirmation from the University First Aid Portal. Please do not reply to this email.
